SELECT t.NAME name, t.concat op, DATEDIFF(CURDATE(),t.riqi) AS days, t.riqi riqi FROM ( SELECT s.NAME, s.concat, MAX( r.riqi ) AS riqi FROM scyf s LEFT JOIN scyfservers r ON s.NAME = r.NAME WHERE ( s.boss IS NULL OR s.boss != 1 ) GROUP BY s.NAME, s.concat ) t WHERE t.riqi IS NULL OR t.riqi < DATE_SUB( CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY ) ORDER BY t.riqi DESC
select distinct name as name from scyfservers where name like concat('%', #{name}, '%') order by name limit 20
